goal: Implement HTTP handlers (auth routes + user profile), JWT auth middleware, rate limiting on auth endpoints, and wire Identity context into cmd/api/main.go router.

tasks.name: JWT auth middleware
tasks.action: Implement JWT validation middleware in internal/common/auth/. Extracts Bearer token from Authorization header, validates JWT, injects UserID + Email into request context. Reusable by all bounded contexts.
microSteps: Implement context.go: UserContext struct (UserID uuid.UUID, Email string). ContextKey type. UserFromContext(ctx) (*UserContext, error). ContextWithUser(ctx, *UserContext) context.Context

Implement middleware.go: JWTMiddleware(tokenValidator) func(http.Handler) http.Handler — extracts Bearer token, validates, injects UserContext into context. Returns 401 JSON for missing/invalid tokens.
Write middleware_test.go: test valid token → context populated, missing header → 401, invalid token → 401, expired token → 401

tasks.name: HTTP handlers (auth + profile)
tasks.action: Implement HTTP handlers in internal/identity/ports/. Auth handlers: register, login, refresh (cookie-based), logout. User handlers: get profile, update profile. Rate limiting on auth endpoints.
microSteps: Implement auth_handler.go: AuthHandler struct with app command handlers. Routes() chi.Router returning mounted routes. POST /auth/register — parse JSON body, call RegisterHandler, return 201 + access token + set refresh cookie. POST /auth/login — parse body, call AuthenticateHandler, return access token + set refresh cookie. POST /auth/refresh — read refresh token from cookie, call RefreshHandler, return new access token + rotate cookie. POST /auth/logout — read cookie, call LogoutHandler, clear cookie.
Write auth_handler_test.go: test register (201 + cookie set), login (200 + cookie), refresh (200 + new cookie), logout (200 + cookie cleared). Use httptest.
Implement user_handler.go: UserHandler struct. Routes() chi.Router. GET /users/me — extract UserContext from JWT middleware, return user profile. PATCH /users/me — update display name.
Write user_handler_test.go: test get profile with valid context, update profile, missing auth → 401

tasks.name: Wire into main.go router
tasks.action: Update cmd/api/main.go to create the Identity application and mount auth + user routes on the chi router. Add JWT middleware to protected routes group.
microSteps: Update main.go: create identity.NewApplication(pool, publisher, cfg.JWTSecret, 15*time.Minute, 14*24*time.Hour). Create AuthHandler and UserHandler. Mount /auth/* routes (public, rate-limited). Mount /users/* routes (protected by JWT middleware). Add rate limiting middleware to auth routes group.
Verify build succeeds and go vet passes

commitMessage: feat(identity): HTTP handlers, JWT middleware, rate limiting, router integration
